svg.aria-label: Simulated load per server: random assignment versus power of two choices
svg.text: Random vs power of two choices
100 servers, 10,000 requests; bars = requests per server, sorted
Sampling just two servers and picking the less loaded collapses the spread. In the balls-into-bins model the
maximum load drops from Θ(log n / log log n) above average to Θ(log log n): an exponential improvement.
